title: Contacts CRUD API with type filtering and search
description: Implement full CRUD for contacts: create, list (paginated with type and search filters), update, soft-delete. Contacts have a type discriminator (BROKER, SHIPPER, CONSIGNEE, FACTORING) and payment terms fields. All endpoints scoped to organizationId via auth middleware. Note: CONCERNS.md flags dispatch-api has no lint command — validationCommand excludes lint.
acceptanceCriteria: POST /api/v1/contacts returns 201 with contact data including generated UUID id
POST requires type (BROKER, SHIPPER, CONSIGNEE, FACTORING) and companyName as required fields

POST accepts all Contact model fields: contactName, phone, email, mcNumber, address, city, state, zip, paymentTerms (default 'net_30'), paymentTermsDays (default 30), quickPayDiscount (nullable Decimal), carrierPacketSentAt, notes
GET /api/v1/contacts returns paginated list with default limit 25, max 100; supports ?type= filter, ?search= (matches companyName, contactName), ?sort=&order=
Soft delete via DELETE sets deletedAt; all queries filter WHERE deletedAt IS NULL
quickPayDiscount stored and returned as string-serialized Decimal (per pagination standard)
All endpoints require auth middleware; contact scoped to organizationId matching authenticated user's orgId
Yup validation schemas for CreateContactInput and UpdateContactInput
Entity IDs use uuid format (per cross-feature decision L-009)
validationCommand: cd hussle-app-dispatch-api && npx jest && npx tsc --noEmit
